The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic For hazardous chemical/item, all precautionary measure as per regulation from the point of transportation/ handling/ storage/ safety/ health/ environment to be undertaken/ specified before dispatch. During dispatch, proper symbol for the hazard/ MSDS/ Batch No./ date of manufacturing/ Gross Weight/ Net Weight/ shelf Life etc are to be written/ printed/ pasted on the body of the packing. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Generic Products supplied shall be nontoxic and harmless to health. In the case of toxic materials, Material Safety Data Sheet may be furnished along with the material. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF SUPPLY: 1. The vendor must supply 2 nos. of new argon gas cylinder filled with ultra-high purity (>99.999%) Argon G as at the commencement of the contract i.e. within 30 days from the date of issue of Purchase Order. 2. The details of the argon gas cylinders are as follows: i. Water capacity: ~47 L

ii. Gas volume: ~6–7 m³ iii. Filling pressure: 140–150 kg/cm² (≈ 150–200 bar) iv. Cylinder type: Seamless steel (high-pressure) v. Standard compliance: IS 7285 (India) or equivalent vi. Valve outlet: CGA 580 or equivalent high-purity connection vii. The cylinders should have name plate containing the followings: · Test pressure and date · Next due test date · Cylinder serial number · Compliance with Gas Cylinder Rules 2016 & IS 7285 3. The vendor must submit cylinder certificate from the certifying agencies like PESO, Nagpur. 4. The refilling of the cylinders with the ultra high purity (>99.999%) Argon Gas shall be carried out based o n the requirement basis. The minimum nos. of cylinders to be refilled at time is 2 (two) and the maximum must be 4 (four) nos. only. 5. After receiving email communications from IGMH, the vendor must arrange for pickup of the empty cylind ers (quantity will be mentioned in the email) within 7 days. 6. The vendor must refill the empty cylinders with ultra high purity Argon Gas (>99.999%) and must return t he same within 7 days from the date of pickup. 7. The details of the ultra-high purity Argon Gas is as follows: i. Grade: Ultra High Purity (UHP) Argon ii. Typical purity: 99.999% (5N) – minimum acceptable iii. Critical impurity limits: Impurity Limit (Typical for Spark OES) · Oxygen (O₂): ≤ 0.2 – 1 ppm · Moisture (H₂O): ≤ 0.2 – 1 ppm · Nitrogen (N₂): ≤ 0.4 – 5 ppm · CO + CO₂: ≤ 0.1 – 1 pp · Hydrocarbons (THC): ≤ 0.1 – 0.5 ppm 8. Argon Gas Purity Test Certificate: i. The successful supplier has to submit the purity certificate of the Argon Gas from an y NABL accredited laboratory with each refilling consignment. OR ii. The successful supplier should submit OEM Test Certificate along with the supplies. After receipt of material at IGMH, IGMH has right to test the composition of Argon Gas for i mpurities level through NABL accredited laboratory. The bidder shall provide acceptance o f the same on their company’s letter head. 9. PAYMENT TERMS & CONDITIONS: i. Payment will be made within 30 days from the date of receipt of tax Invoice and app roval from competent authority.

ii. The vendor must submit the Tax Invoice against the supply of 2 new filled argon gas cylinders at the time of delivery of the cylinder along with purity certificate & cylinder test certificate. iii. The vendor must raise Tax Invoice against each refilling activity and the payment sh all be made within 30 days from the date of receipt of tax invoice. 10. Eligibility Criteria: i. Capability Criteria: The bidder should have capacity & capability to provide the tendered services. ii. The bidder should submit signed & stamped copy of bid document as a token of acceptance of all the ter ms & conditions of the tender. .
